sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Rust only. Delivery: crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs ~L231-260 (socket_available → fresh_injection_verdict → select_rung). u1: branch on recipient.harness — for Omp|Pi skip the verdict entirely and hand to the transport (the extension event stream; confirm which Transport impl serves omp in crates/transport and that it buffers a steer during a turn). Keep select_rung pure; add the harness gate one level up. u2: a notice scheduler in the drain (crates/daemon/src/delivery or pointer/worker.rs pattern) that, for rows pending > notice_after_secs (config.rs), enqueues a control message to the SENDER seat (from `pij-rs`, body `still queued: …`), once per row, and `delivered late` on completion when delay > threshold; CLI prints outstanding notices on stderr (crates/cli/src/main.rs, like the stale-card warning). Wire additive only.

value.rationale: u1 is ~20 lines and urgent — ship it in the first commit; u2 follows on the same branch

value.name: omp/pi bypass the composer veto
value.paths: crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs, crates/transport (read only unless a stream fact is wrong), tests
value.test_strategy: RED-first: fake gate counting calls; live control on main

value.note: Default: each coder gets its own worktree, branching off the PM's plan branch; unit lands back onto the plan branch (PM merges — coders never merge). Shared-tree work is the retro-proven #1 hazard (staged sweeps, untrustworthy greens) — only choose it for trivially disjoint single-wave work, and then file-scoped `git add` only, never -A. REMEMBER: fences partition WRITE intent, not the build — a mid-refactor sibling can still break your compile, so waves must respect build dependencies, and a broken workspace build is a PM composition concern, not a coder's to fix cross-fence.

value.steps: u1 commit + live proof FIRST (so it can ship alone if u2 slips); u2; cargo receipts; harness checks; PR

value.when: after composition (or after solo-pm coding), before the PR into main
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this impl-guide + full branch diff; priority = plan promises, composition seams, interface drift, correctness, contract-test gaps

value.text: Keep to the named paths; ask prime before widening.
